experience.heroSubtitle: Find a little peace. Challenge a familiar thought. Hear what the other side has to say.
experience.godDescription: A gentle perspective. A moment of clarity.
experience.devilDescription: A sharper truth. A little mischief.
experience.councilDescription: Bring one dilemma. Hear both sides. The final word is always yours.
experience.ritualSubtitle: One minute. A little room to breathe.
experience.disclaimer: Fictional AI companions for reflection and entertainment. You remain the author of your choices.

welcome.god: You can set it down here.
welcome.council:
One dilemma.
Two very different voices.

welcomeBody.god: Bring a worry, a hope, or a question. A gentle, Bible-inspired AI perspective awaits.
welcomeBody.devil: A little wit, a different angle, and no need to pretend you have it all figured out.
welcomeBody.council: A compassionate perspective. A provocative perspective. A little more clarity for your next step.

god: I feel overwhelmed. Where do I begin?
How can I forgive someone who hurt me?
Help me find one good thing today.
devil: What excuse am I making today?
I keep putting things off. Call me out.
Am I playing it too safe?
council: Should I give someone a second chance?
Should I stay comfortable or take a risk?
How do I stop caring what people think?

experience.aiConsentBody: For AI replies, your message and recent conversation context are sent to our server hosted by Cloudflare, then to OpenAI. History and your journal are kept on this device. You can decline and still use the journal and breathing ritual. You can withdraw permission in Settings.
